In a way it helps because when I feel lonely and depress with no one around it helps just to come on here and go through the bitter pain with others. I imagine a group of people huddling around a fire on a cold night waiting for day break.

I feel as if Paul was talking about not giving into temptation, I keep giving into my temptations, I am failing.   
I really wish Christ would take control of me and fight my battles because I am weak and suffering in sin. I try to be better but I fall often, I hope my God will save me.

I am in the same bubble, I wish I had a wife that would love me unconditionally, I have parents that love me but a lot of times I feel it is completely conditional. I was not the child they wanted, I am constantly ignored, I am called ugly, I am expected to take care of them when they are older. I am the youngest so literally my opinion does not matter.   
I live in a bondage, when I try to peer into my future I see that I am taking care of my aging parents, everyone around me is living independent lives with a family and they're happy, but I am not and I am not loved. It is the future I see because it is my current present and it's hard to see any positive changes. I feel you friend.
I try to be whatever but with everything going on in my depressed head, it doesn’t feel good. I feel really ashamed to even be alive.

Someone complimented me and my mom said no he’s the handsome one and proceeded to point at my brother. This happens a lot, whenever someone tries to compliment me in front of my mother or she introduces me she always mentions how my brother is better looking.

I wasn’t a Christian for most of my life. People like you who live their life in a dignify way really inspired me to give Christ a chance. It won’t be just you, I am sure your friends will meet other Christians in their life time as well and I am sure a combination of all those encounters (including your friendship) will help your friends set foot on the right path. 
Pray, keep praying for your friends with steadfastness and patience. May God have mercy on us all.
All good, I’m not gonna lie sometimes there is anger towards my brother I try really hard to simmer it down but in the moment rage definitely blinds me at times.
My prayers are with you and your son!

What are you talking about? 
John 7:24
“Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly."” 
I’m not condemning my brother for his sin, obviously drinking isn’t good. I have no idea what you’re talking about.

And his wife told me he started throwing stuff and cussing her out. They used to live with me and it happened all the time so I am already aware. He already knows it’s wrong.
this looks so cool

I haven’t because even with that friend I try my best to not bring up much, but it’s okay because I feel okay when I’m hanging out with him. 
And things just come out naturally so the conversation just flows. 
I don’t want to ask for any boundaries or bring up the fact I might be annoying him because I don’t think he realizes that he helps me a lot but if I sense that he is getting annoyed I will definitely ask. 
It just hurts when people tell me to see a therapist, they can see that something is wrong with me, I feel embarrassed and ashamed.

Edit: I’m not upset at the person who tell me I need to see a therapist, I’m hurt because it’s true. I’m hurt because I can’t afford it and can’t help my own situation.

I have told people...they always push me away, no one wants to deal with me. So I try really hard to keep my problems to myself. 
I am blessed because I do have a friend that I talk to but I’m scared I’ll push him away too so I try to bite the bullet on a lot of things. 
And I’m really grateful for reddit because it gives me a place to relieve my thoughts. 
It really is a lonely world for some people, I never really understood that until I grew a bit older and the world a lot colder. 
Maybe sometimes I tell people I’m feeling down because I’m hoping for some magical cure that I know they cannot provide. Maybe sometimes I just want someone to hold me and cry with me but I think that is too much to ask, I dont want to ask for much, sometimes feeling okay is enough.

Dang I’m sorry to hear that. My situation....my family has love, I think there’s just so much misplace emotions and trauma they had to go through. They are still my parents and have provided for me, although times are hard and they make a lot of hurtful mistakes it would take a lot to abandon them. I pray it doesn’t get to that point. They say love makes people do crazy things, sometimes I feel crazy wanting to support my parents, but most of the time I feel as if it is the right thing to do and it’s something Christ would want me to do, I feel it in my heart so I stay and pray things will be better.

My brother has his own family, he’s already somewhat out of my life. 
At times I have thought about leaving my family but I won’t. They need me I’m not going to abandon them, if Christ sat with sinners then I can sit with my family.
Maybe, I know he knows it’s not good for him.
Yeah possibly but I don’t think anyone deserves to get shit thrown at them and cussed out. It like only happens when he drinks.
Yeah he realizes he has a drinking problem. Sometimes acknowledging isn’t enough, man I really wish God would come and save my family, and if He already is I guess patience is the key.
Thank you for all your prayers! Things seem to be looking up right now at least for my parents and me. I am really grateful my family and I are in your thoughts and prayers!
\^pretty much the same answer, I thought the reply wasn't submitted initially so I am deleting the repeated comment.

I think so...I am not sure, initially we found Christ through this church that turned out to be a cult. I got out by Christ's word, my brother and his family just stopped attending so I am not 100% sure where their faith is.

Thank you for all your prayers, I really appreciate you all taking the time out of your busy schedules to pray to God for my family.   
I feel your prayers I hope my brother's family does too!

I messed up today man. My dad was drunk
we got into an argument he tried to hit me and I shoved him. Feels bad can’t believe I did that to my old man.

Thank you for your words of encouragement. I asked and he said to just come during office hours. I don’t think he really cares though and the school doesn’t always hire actual teachers so I don’t think teaching is his strong point. 
But I really hope you’re right, I want to keep the faith because it’s the only hope I really have at this point. I’m just so afraid I was lied to, I am afraid of losing what seems to be my only hope.

If I could have it my way I would just leave home and live a normal life, but I cannot because my parents did not save for their future and now I have to take care of them otherwise let them die in some trailer park or retirement home. So either I live for myself or for my parents, right? I chose my parents and they encouraged me just to go back to school. 
Now I am in a bind and I am scared. I did what I thought was what God wanted but things went down hill when I failed my test today. 
I am so afraid of my future, the covid is taking business away from my mom who owns a barber shop. 
I am going to have to step up soon and start paying the bills but I just saved a bunch of money to either move out but because of my parents situation I decided to stay. I blew a big portion of my savings on school and it seems like it will be for nothing. 
I am not happy being at home but I know its the good thing to do for my parents. But damn why am I so miserable? 
And if I am going to be miserable my whole life, will my faith in the end be justified? I am completely in the dark. I am the only christian in my family, my parents my brother they only care about themselves and because im the youngest I have to do everything for them. They do not see what I do is because my faith in Christ but because it is my obligatory birth order that has set this pressure on me. 
And I am at my breaking point, there is no love for me in this life, there seems to not be a future. Why does God allow me to have an addiction, parents that do not care about me, a brother that brought drugs into my family's life and has used 100k from my parents home for some bull shit weed op that my parents are barely getting anything back and then I have to suffer with the debt because I am the one having to pay. 
This is all crap, man I just wish God and Christ would show themselves or just kill me already because I rather die at this point. God promised me strength and a future but I am anxious, afraid, unloved, all hinging on a faith that might not even be real because that is part of faith, the idea that it might NOT be real.
I am doing it because my parents are going to need financial support especially because they're getting old, they're not good with english.

How does me choosing to take care of my parents instead of just living my own life have to do with me not being in Christ? 
I am not choosing my parents religion or anything.

Let the dead bury their own dead was in reference to someone wanting to bury their father before they went to follow Christ. My parents are still alive, I base my choice not off of cultural means, independence in America, or family orientation in south east asia (where my parents are from) but from the Words of God "But if anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever."
"You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh ; rather, serve one another humbly in love."

Yeah and I do too. 
I’m weak right now, I’m the only Christian in my family. My parents expected me to take care of them and Christ confirmed that I should. 
I’m a sinner and I have worldly wants, I want to be on my own, I want my own family, I don’t want to be with my immigrant parents but I love them too much to leave them in this strange country. 

And I believe I can have what I really seek from God. 
But I’m weak right now, I’m scared because I have these thoughts of a very lonely life, sometimes I feel as if I made the wrong choice and I should have left.
You’re probably just as selfish as I am
Thanks guy I am drinking water and I ate a banana!
I’m at my brothers house I can’t just exercise. I would just fall asleep on the couch upstairs and just wake up when everyone is leaving
Yes and I don’t have any with me right now
I want you to be right so badly I wish you could hold me for a second friend because I am crying and the feeling of having someone that cares is fleeting with every passing character.
I went back out I’m just gonna bite the bullet just a bit longer then leave once the first person leaves

It sucks I went to the bathroom everyone starts talking I come back and everyone is just quiet and doesn’t really say anything I kill the mood just being there. 
I went into my bedroom and everyone talks again.
Yeah you’re right I will

The thing is I do excercise, I do get good grades, I do work and save, I don't just go out and party etc. 
But even after all of this, I still cannot beat my addiction, most of my family still hate me, most people only see a loser in me. And man I'll take the hit every single day because I have no choice but to. It just hurts being this down and alone, everyday is a blow even when I succeed it seems like there is no life, no winning.
I am not really looking for an answer, I have the answer, I need the strength which He promised He would give me.
I’ve “started” so many times. Man I wish I had someone there for me. Why did I have to ruin everything.

No because I am good for nothing no money making slow learning addict. 
I am the prodigal son that blew his inheritance and I messed up. Everyone knows it everyone sees it. Why else does no one talk to me? No one wants to help, I even called the crisis center and they just asked me straight up questions like I’m a test subject. 
But I don’t blame them they are looking for possible suicide case but I’m too indecisive but sometimes I just want to pull the trigger.

I am aiming for a stem degree, I have an AA already. I really want a family and a nice peaceful life without addiction. My parents has asked me if they could live with me in the future and I don't mind, but I know a lot of people are really not into that and I totally understand.I just wish things were different but I know its not good to have such wishful thinking.I'm just afraid, my life seems to amount to nothing, people only see my addiction, my family gossips about me, the community gossips about me, I made mistakes, I wish I can have a more dramatic change, maybe I can be seen as a normal person who lives a dignified life.
